metadata.title: A 16-Channel Acoustic Dataset for Passive Ground-Based Monitoring of Small Drones
metadata.description:
Synchronized 16-channel acoustic recordings for passive ground-based monitoring of small UAVs, collected with an SMD-CR16 planar cross array: 200 hovering DJI Flip recordings, 28 field background recordings, and 45 controlled re-recordings of non-UAV sounds. The 273 physical recordings comprise 4,368 mono WAV files (48 kHz, 16-bit PCM), totaling 7.221 hours.

The UAV subset spans four azimuths, four heights (5–30 m), six horizontal distances (5–70 m), and quiet outdoor and road-adjacent urban environments. Microphone coordinates, recording-level JSON metadata, CSV indexes, replay source provenance and integrity hashes accompany the audio. Controlled replay source excerpts were selected from FSD50K entries licensed under CC0 1.0.

The archive includes validation code and results, benchmark implementations, original feature and CNN support modules, configurations, recording-level folds and predictions, training histories, summary tables, plotting data, and a portable reproduction entry point. It covers detection, negative-sample composition, azimuth classification and supplementary distance regression. Trained weights and feature caches are regenerated by the supplied code. No models were retrained during packaging.

Maintenance correction, 9 November 2026 (same dataset version 1.1.0 and DOI): The original 20.35 GB archive is retained unchanged. Download it together with UAV_Acoustic_Dataset_v1.1.0_Maintenance_Patch_20261109.zip (about 55.6 MB). Extract the original archive first, then extract the patch into the same folder and replace matching files. The patch corrects citation information and a standalone detection-export dependency, and supplies the previously missing 16-channel sweep calibration input. The 273 main recordings, 4,368 main WAV files and archived experiment results are unchanged; the separate calibration input is excluded from those counts. See README.md for instructions.
metadata.notes:
Associated research manuscript

This dataset is described and evaluated in the accompanying manuscript A 16-Channel Acoustic Dataset for Passive Ground-Based Monitoring of Small Drones by Huilong Wang, Peng Chen, Zhimin Chen, and Yuye Liu.

The manuscript documents the acquisition of synchronized acoustic recordings using a 16-channel planar cross microphone array, spatial annotations covering azimuth, horizontal distance, and height, and quality-control procedures for the released dataset. It further presents reproducible baselines for acoustic UAV detection and four-class azimuth classification, including evaluations of interchannel spatial information.

Under the reported evaluation protocols, the UAV-detection baseline achieves a balanced accuracy of 0.917 ± 0.012, while the four-class azimuth classification baseline achieves a macro-F1 of 0.910 ± 0.012.

The manuscript's publication details and DOI will be added when available.
